title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A fix that would have come undone
summary: No change to the extension. The previous release stopped two tests from launching adb by name, which a rename would have silently undone.

highlights.title: No coupling to a private name
highlights.description: The two Logcat tests stopped the stream by replacing a private method on the instance. Renaming it during a refactor would have quietly let them launch a real adb process again, with every test still passing. They now replace the adb entry point itself.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Checked across the whole suite: with the adb entry point made to fail on purpose, all 6450 tests still pass, so no test anywhere reaches a real process launch.
